record_type_quote: In this study we replicate the experiment by Fischbacher et al. in Russia.

targets.authors: Fischbacher, U., Gächter, S., & Fehr, E.
targets.title: Are people conditionally cooperative? Evidence from public goods experiment.
targets.evidence_quote:
The goal of this study was to replicate the experiments of Fischbacher et al. (2001) in
four different locations in Russia.
targets.outcome_quote:
The share of conditional cooperators in our Russian subject pools
is comparable to the one found by Fischbacher et al. in a Swiss subject pool. However,
the distribution of the other types differs from the one found in Switzerland.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors compare the conditional-cooperator share as agreeing and explicitly contrast the other types; no overall verdict overrides these comparisons.

reasoning: Identity verified by title, both authors and printed DOI; six-page published article with references. Only Fischbacher et al. (2001) is explicitly retested; subsequent comparisons and background papers are not independent targets.
